identity.name: RM-014: From HoReCa to IT Operations — A Gardener's Personal Transition
identity.description: A personal, strategic roadmap for the Gardener (Voodoo/Dima) to transition from an 8-year career as a multi-site coffee shop Operations Manager in Russia to a remote Operations Manager role in the IT sector. The ultimate goal is to enable a location-independent lifestyle, starting with a trial move to Vietnam, while continuing the development of the Mandala project as a key portfolio asset.

meta.purpose: To provide a clear, structured, and philosophically aligned path for the Gardener's professional and personal transformation. This roadmap is a living document that will be updated as the journey progresses.

context_for_sr.who: Voodoo (Dima), the Gardener and co-creator of Mandala Symbiosis. He has 8+ years of experience managing a multi-location coffee business in Russia.
context_for_sr.why_change: The Russian coffee business is under increasing pressure (taxes, costs). More importantly, the Gardener is experiencing burnout and desires a new challenge. He wishes to transition to a remote career that offers more freedom, creativity, and the ability to live abroad.
context_for_sr.why_operations_management: After analysis, an Operations Manager role in IT was identified as the most strategic entry point. This role leverages the Gardener's strongest existing skills (managing complex, multi-site operations, leading teams, optimizing processes) while having significantly lower competition compared to entry-level Project Management roles. His 8-year experience is a direct asset, not something to downplay.
context_for_sr.the_mandala_lever: The ongoing development of 'Mandala Symbiosis' is not a hobby. It is a critical portfolio project. It serves as concrete proof of the Gardener's ability to: 1) Architect and manage an IT system, 2) Use modern project management tools (Asana, Kanban, GitHub), 3) Understand the full development lifecycle (from concept to deployment), and 4) Bridge the gap between operational thinking and technical execution. It is his 'Trojan Horse' into IT interviews.
context_for_sr.the_goal: Secure a remote Operations Manager / Chief of Staff role in an IT startup or distributed team with a starting salary of 80,000 - 120,000 RUB. Use this as a stable foundation for a trial relocation to Vietnam, where he can work, recharge, and continue developing Mandala into a more significant project and company.

target_role_clarification.title: Two Types of Remote Operations Manager — A Two-Stage Strategy
target_role_clarification.description: The role of 'remote Operations Manager' exists in two distinct forms. The Gardener's strategy is to target Type 1 first as the most efficient entry point, then use that stability to level up to Type 2.

type_1_geo_dependent.name: Type 1: Remote but Geo-Dependent
type_1_geo_dependent.where_to_find: Localized job boards (hh.ru, Habr Career, Geekjob, Getmatch, Superjob, Zarplata.ru, Avito, TrudVsem), companies with a legal entity in Russia/CIS.
type_1_geo_dependent.requirements: Often requires self-employment status (IP/samozanyatye), may have timezone expectations.
type_1_geo_dependent.competition: Moderate. Market note: 2025 shows 11-36% fewer vacancies, 20-30% more resumes. Companies hire precisely, not in bulk.
type_1_geo_dependent.gardener_fit: IDEAL. His 8-year experience and 'Mandala' portfolio are a killer advantage here. This is the immediate target.

type_2_geo_independent.name: Type 2: Fully Geo-Independent (Global)
type_2_geo_independent.where_to_find: International platforms (LinkedIn, RemoteOK, We Work Remotely, Levels.fyi for salary data), global startups.
type_2_geo_independent.requirements: Fluent English (B2+) is MANDATORY. Experience in distributed teams, high self-organization.
type_2_geo_independent.competition: High, but the pool of opportunities is vastly larger.
type_2_geo_independent.gardener_fit: POTENTIAL. Requires leveling up English to a confident B2. This is the long-term target after securing a Type 1 role.

the_two_stage_strategy.stage_1: Secure a Type 1 role on the Russian market. This provides stable income and the ability to work remotely from Vietnam (within a compatible timezone).
the_two_stage_strategy.stage_2: While working and living abroad, actively improve English to B2+. After 1-2 years of commercial remote experience in IT (Mandala + the new role), transition to the global Type 2 market for significantly higher compensation.

target_role_clarification.note_for_sr: This clarification is crucial. Do not confuse the two types. The immediate, achievable goal is Type 1. Type 2 is the inspiring, long-term vision that follows.

job_search_platforms.title: Complete Job Search Platform Arsenal
job_search_platforms.description: Curated list of all relevant platforms for the Gardener's job search, organized by priority and phase.

hh_ru.role: Dominant platform in Russia — 75-80% of IT hires go through hh.ru. High volume, high competition. Requires strong resume to stand out.

habr_career.role: Professional IT job board. ~700K resumes, ~27 applications per vacancy (much cleaner than hh.ru). 63% of candidates get employer response.
habr_career.note: hh.ru acquired Habr in 2025 — pending integration means one profile will work across both platforms.

superjob.role: Second largest traditional job board. Still significant traffic, worth cross-posting resume.

geekjob.role: Anonymous job search with Telegram integration. Automatically reposts your resume to Telegram communities (~135K subscribers). Direct employer contact without intermediaries.

getmatch.role: Telegram-bot matchmaking service with live HR experts. Helps with selection and interview preparation. Free for candidates.

tenchat.role: Professional social network for informal networking and direct employer outreach.

habr_portal.role: Use for networking and reputation building. Comments, articles increase visibility in professional community.

zarplata_ru.role: Large aggregator, 6th by traffic in Russia.

rabota_ru.role: Major aggregator with large resume database.

avito.role: 3rd by traffic in 'Jobs' category. IT positions also listed here.

trudvsem.role: State portal 'Work of Russia'. 2nd by traffic. Good for large companies and public sector.

telegram_channels.role: Now one of the primary IT job search channels. Geekjob auto-crossposts. Find and subscribe to 5-10 thematic channels.

dream_job.role: Employee reviews, real salaries, interview experiences. Use before applying to verify employer.

glassdoor.role: Global equivalent of Dream Job. Reviews, salaries, company ratings. Use for Type 2 market research.

levels_fyi.role: Global standard for compensation comparison. Standardized levels (L4, E5, M1) across companies. Essential for Type 2 preparation.
levels_fyi.note: VPN required in Russia. Limited data for Russian market — use Getmatch salary calculator locally.

getmatch_calculator.role: Salary calculator within Getmatch. Shows real market data for Russian IT salaries.

linkedin.role: Global professional network. Required for Type 2 positioning. Also used by Russian IT professionals. Create in P2, actively use in P3-P4.

hh_setka.role: HeadHunter's internal social network. Allows direct outreach to hiring managers and recruiters.

corporate_sites.role: Many IT companies (Selectel, Oblakoteka, etc.) publish vacancies first on their own sites or Telegram channels. Monitor target companies directly.

market_reality_2025.note: The market has shifted: 11-36% fewer vacancies, 20-30% more resumes. Companies do targeted 'sniper' hiring. One resume on hh.ru is not enough. Diversification and networking are key.
market_reality_2025.implication: Gardener must be active across multiple platforms, build network, and use Mandala portfolio as differentiator.

education_and_certifications.title: Recommended Courses & Learning Path
education_and_certifications.description: A curated list of courses to strengthen the Gardener's profile. These compensate for the lack of a formal IT degree and provide the necessary vocabulary and frameworks.
education_and_certifications.important_note: List these courses on LinkedIn and resume as 'in progress' immediately upon enrollment. This demonstrates proactive learning and serious intent to employers.

courses.name: COO / Операционный директор в IT
courses.why: This is a ready-made program for entering the role. It covers all key areas: operational management, finance, strategy, and project management. Ideal for systematizing existing practical experience and translating it into IT language.

courses.name: Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt
courses.why: An international 'quality mark' in process improvement. Shows employers you possess a proven methodology for optimization, not just 'problem-solving'. A strong argument that compensates for the lack of a formal degree.

courses.name: Chief of Staff 101
courses.why: Clarifies the role of a 'right hand to the CEO', which often overlaps with Operations Manager in startups. Helps position the Gardener as a strategic partner, not just an executor.

courses.name: Certified Chief of Staff: Стратегический Партнёр CEO
courses.why: Provides practical tools and frameworks for managing priorities, communication, and influencing without formal authority. Key skills for a strong Chief of Staff.

courses.name: Google Project Management Certificate
courses.why: Provides standard terminology and frameworks (Agile, Scrum) used in the IT industry. Validates intuitive knowledge and helps speak the same language as future colleagues.

learning_strategy.step_1: Start with the foundation courses in parallel: COO (OTUS) and Google PM Certificate (Coursera). These provide the core vocabulary and structure.
learning_strategy.step_2: Enroll in Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt. This is a longer-term, highly respected certification that adds formal weight to the resume.
learning_strategy.step_3: Complete the shorter enhancement courses (Chief of Staff 101, etc.) in between, as they require less time commitment.
learning_strategy.immediate_action: Add all courses to LinkedIn 'Licenses & Certifications' section with status 'In Progress'.

phase_1.name: Phase 1: Foundation — Packaging the Past
phase_1.goal: To systematically translate 8 years of operational experience in HoReCa into the language and frameworks valued in the IT sector, and to establish a solid learning and development system.
phase_1.context_for_sr: This phase is about building the launchpad. The Gardener must reframe his own narrative. He is not a 'newbie' but an 'experienced operational leader adapting his skills to a new domain'. The focus is on building the assets (audit, portfolio, learning plan) that will be used in the next phases.

tasks.task: Audit and translate HoReCa experience
tasks.deliverable: A personal document (Notion/private) listing key achievements from 8 years of management, rewritten in IT/Operations language.
tasks.why: To build the raw material for his future resume and interview stories.

tasks.task: Initiate structured learning: Google Project Management Certificate
tasks.deliverable: Enroll in and begin the Google Project Management Certificate on Coursera. Complete at least first 2 modules.
tasks.why: Provides standard terminology and frameworks (Agile, Scrum) used in IT.

tasks.task: Start a public development log (devlog) for Mandala
tasks.deliverable: Begin posting weekly updates in a public channel about Mandala development.
tasks.why: Creates a public timeline of IT project management in action.

tasks.task: Focus English learning on Business & Operations
tasks.deliverable: 2-3 conversational sessions per week focused on business topics.
tasks.why: Conversational English is key for remote roles.

tasks.task: Enroll in COO course (OTUS)
tasks.deliverable: Registration completed, first module started.
tasks.why: Systematizes operational knowledge and translates it to IT context.

tasks.task: Subscribe to Telegram job channels
tasks.deliverable: Subscribe to 5-10 thematic Telegram channels for IT vacancies. Set up Geekjob account for auto-crosspost.
tasks.why: Start passive monitoring early. Build awareness of market demands and language.

phase_2.name: Phase 2: Deepening and Packaging — Building the Portfolio
phase_2.goal: To transform the Mandala project and the Gardener's experience into a polished, professional portfolio and resume that is ready for the job market. Create profiles on all relevant platforms.
phase_2.context_for_sr: This is the 'assembly' phase. The Gardener now has the raw materials from Phase 1 and must package them into compelling artifacts (GitHub profile, resume, LinkedIn, platform profiles) that will attract recruiters. The Mandala project is the centerpiece.

tasks.task: Transform Mandala's GitHub README into a portfolio piece
tasks.deliverable: Professional, English-language README.md outlining vision, architecture, tech stack, and Gardener's role.
tasks.why: First thing a recruiter will see on GitHub.

tasks.task: Create and optimize a LinkedIn profile for 'Operations Manager'
tasks.deliverable: Complete LinkedIn profile with professional photo and headline. Add courses with 'In Progress' status.
tasks.why: LinkedIn is the primary hunting ground for recruiters on global market. Also used by Russian IT professionals.

tasks.task: Draft the first version of the IT-focused resume
tasks.deliverable: 1-page resume in English, tailored for Operations Manager roles.
tasks.why: Baseline to iterate upon based on feedback.

tasks.task: Complete a Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt certification
tasks.deliverable: Certificate from a reputable provider.
tasks.why: Adds formal credentials in process improvement.

tasks.task: Register on all primary platforms
tasks.deliverable: Profiles created on hh.ru, Habr Career, Superjob, Geekjob, Getmatch, Zarplata.ru. Upload resume to each.
tasks.why: Maximum coverage. Note: hh.ru × Habr Career integration means one profile may soon work across both.

tasks.task: Research salary data
tasks.deliverable: Use Getmatch salary calculator for Russian market data. Browse Levels.fyi for global benchmarks (via VPN). Check Dream Job for real salary reports by company.
tasks.why: Calibrate salary expectations before interviews.

phase_3.name: Phase 3: Active Search — Testing the Market
phase_3.goal: To actively apply for positions, gather feedback from the market through 'practice' interviews, and secure a job offer that meets the target criteria.
phase_3.context_for_sr: This is the most psychologically challenging phase. Frame first 5-10 applications as 'market research' to gather feedback. Mandala project is anchor and proof of competence.

tasks.task: Begin applying for 'practice' roles
tasks.deliverable: Submit 10-15 'stretch' applications on HeadHunter, Habr Career, and Superjob to test resume.
tasks.why: Reduces pressure and calibrates pitch.

tasks.task: Master the 'Mandala Pitch'
tasks.deliverable: 2-minute confident story about Mandala project.
tasks.why: Differentiates him from every other candidate.

tasks.task: Targeted applications and networking
tasks.deliverable: Apply to 3-5 highly relevant roles per week. Reach out for informational interviews via TenChat, 'Setka' (HH network), and LinkedIn.
tasks.why: Moves search from quantity to quality. Networking often yields the best offers.

tasks.task: Employer due diligence
tasks.deliverable: Before each interview, check employer on Dream Job for reviews and real salaries.
tasks.why: Avoid toxic workplaces. Enter interviews informed.

tasks.task: Secure a job offer
tasks.deliverable: Receive at least one written job offer for remote Operations Manager with 80,000-120,000 RUB.
tasks.why: Primary metric of success.

phase_4.name: Phase 4: Relocation — The Trial Run in Vietnam
phase_4.goal: To successfully execute a trial relocation to Vietnam while maintaining the new remote role and continuing to develop Mandala.
phase_4.context_for_sr: This phase is an experiment. Success is 'gathering valuable data and experience', not 'staying forever'.

tasks.task: Handle all logistics for a 1-2 month stay
tasks.deliverable: Visa, flights, accommodation, local SIM, backup internet.
tasks.why: Proper preparation reduces anxiety.

tasks.task: Establish a stable work routine in the new location
tasks.deliverable: Find reliable workspace and adapt to time zone.
tasks.why: Most critical operational test.

tasks.task: Continue development of Mandala and personal projects
tasks.deliverable: Maintain devlog, work on Mandala features, optional blog.
tasks.why: Builds personal brand and portfolio.

tasks.task: Evaluate the experience and decide on next steps
tasks.deliverable: Conscious decision: extend, return, or explore another country.
tasks.why: Turns dream into data-driven life decision.

success_metrics.phase_1: Personal experience audit completed. Google PM Certificate in progress. Devlog updated weekly. Enrolled in COO course. Subscribed to 5-10 Telegram channels.
success_metrics.phase_2: Mandala GitHub README is professional. LinkedIn profile complete and optimized. Profiles on hh.ru, Habr Career, Geekjob, Getmatch, Superjob created. Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt certified.
success_metrics.phase_3: Completed 5+ practice interviews. 'Mandala Pitch' is fluid and natural. Checked employers on Dream Job. Received a job offer for 80,000+ RUB as an Operations Manager (remote).
success_metrics.phase_4: Successfully worked remotely from Vietnam for at least 1 month. All work commitments were met. A conscious decision was made regarding the next step.
